description.text: The other XY11 expansion, released on 17 June 2016 alongside Cruel Traitor, in which the mythical Volcanion made its first appearance in the card game, a month before its film. Volcanion-EX is a Fire and Water dual-type Pokémon, and its Ability raises the damage of Fire-type Basic Pokémon. Steelix-EX and M Steelix-EX, the latter a Metal and Fighting dual type, join it with Xerneas BREAK, Pyroar BREAK and Clawitzer BREAK. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 54, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Pokémon Ranger and an Ultra Rare gold Volcanion-EX. In English most of its cards came out in Steam Siege in August 2016.
